title: Klint Kubiak: I put Raiders' problems running the ball on myself

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Klint Kubiak: I put Raiders' problems running the ball on myself
sources.description: The Raiders opened the season with 130 rushing yards in a win over the Dolphins and that was a welcome development after the team finished dead last in rushing during the 2025 season.
